verdict.rationale: Sunbiz collects and publishes user-submitted business filing data, so a policy on AI-training use of that data is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack covers only filing, payment, and record-management tasks and documents no AI-training opt-out or restriction. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access to the e-filing host, not a user-facing control over training use, so it earns no credit.
